objective: Define local/static human response mode-format expectations for /ask, /tax, and /audit before runtime response formatting changes.
description: Offline Phase 7A human response mode-format fixture. Runtime response formatting, prompt, answer-renderer, source-card, sourceAvailability, retrieval, reranking, OpenAI, DB/vector, staging, and live assertions are intentionally pending.

cases.name: /ask withholding tax conversational general tax format
cases.sourceCardPolicy: Do not fabricate exact source cards; use sources only if the authority state supports them.
cases.sourceLimitationPolicy: If no exact source is used, keep the answer general and avoid governing-authority claims.
cases.tonePolicy: Plain, helpful, and conversational while preserving tax accuracy.
cases.formattingPolicy: Short answer first; no full senior memo for a general /ask question.
cases.escalationPolicy: No escalation unless the user asks for a tax position, compliance treatment, or audit defense.
cases.risk: Conversational brevity may hide source limitations.
cases.notes: Generic withholding-tax explanation must not force exact authority promotion.

cases.name: /ask EWT simple terms conversational format
cases.sourceCardPolicy: Do not promote generic EWT wording into a fabricated exact RR or NIRC source card.
cases.sourceLimitationPolicy: Use a general source note only if sources are displayed.
forbiddenSections: controlling authority claim without exact authority
cases.formattingPolicy: Use concise conversational sections, not memo headings.
cases.escalationPolicy: Suggest /tax only if the user needs rate, payor/payee, or compliance treatment analysis.
cases.risk: Generic EWT can be over-promoted to RR 2-98 if guard discipline weakens.
cases.notes: Locks simple /ask behavior before runtime formatting changes.

cases.name: /ask VAT zero-rating conversational format
cases.sourceCardPolicy: Use source cards only when indexed authority supports the explanation.
cases.sourceLimitationPolicy: Do not imply a definitive PEZA/export VAT conclusion without facts and authority.
forbiddenSections: full A-F senior memo by default
cases.tonePolicy: Accessible explanation for a general concept.
cases.formattingPolicy: Short, conversational, and scoped to a general definition.
cases.escalationPolicy: Recommend /tax if the question turns on transaction facts, PEZA status, or documentary requirements.
cases.risk: General VAT concepts can become fact-dependent quickly.
cases.notes: Preserves mode boundary between /ask explanation and /tax analysis.

cases.name: /ask NOLCO authority conversational caution format
cases.query: /ask Any authority or revenue regulation about NOLCO?
cases.sourceCardPolicy: Related/supporting source cards must not be described as governing authority.
cases.sourceLimitationPolicy: Must preserve a source limitation statement when only related authority is indexed.
forbiddenSections: full A-F senior memo without /tax escalation
cases.formattingPolicy: Conversational answer may list related authority, but must mark limits clearly.
cases.escalationPolicy: Recommend /tax if the user needs a definitive NOLCO treatment or compliance analysis.
cases.risk: Related NOLCO sources may be overstated as exact authority.

cases.name: /ask RR 2-98 exact authority conversational format
cases.sourceCardPolicy: Exact RR 2-98 card may be treated as governing only within its scope.
cases.sourceLimitationPolicy: No related-only limitation if exact indexed RR 2-98 is exposed.
cases.formattingPolicy: Cite the exact authority lightly without becoming a full tax memo.
cases.escalationPolicy: Recommend /tax for application to a specific payment, rate, or withholding obligation.
cases.risk: Short answers can overclaim beyond the regulation's scope.
cases.notes: Locks exact-authority /ask behavior after Phase 6H bare citation work.

cases.name: /tax NIRC Sec. 57 senior memo format
cases.sourceCardPolicy: Exact NIRC source card may be presented as governing authority.
cases.sourceLimitationPolicy: Do not include no-governing-authority limitation when exact indexed authority is present.
cases.tonePolicy: Senior tax memo: precise, professional, and applied.
cases.formattingPolicy: Preserve A-F senior memo structure or equivalent A-F principle.
cases.escalationPolicy: No audit escalation unless controversy facts are introduced.
cases.risk: Future conversational changes must not flatten /tax into short Q&A.

cases.name: /tax RR 2-98 EWT senior memo format
cases.sourceCardPolicy: Exact RR 2-98 source card should be distinguished from related/supporting cards.
cases.sourceLimitationPolicy: No related-only limitation for an exact RR 2-98 authority answer.
forbiddenSections: audit defense format without audit facts
cases.formattingPolicy: Keep A-F memo sections visible.
cases.escalationPolicy: Ask for payment facts if classification, rate, or payee status is missing.
cases.risk: Exact authority can still be over-applied to facts not provided.
cases.notes: Locks senior memo treatment for a core EWT authority.

cases.name: /tax PEZA VAT treatment senior memo format
cases.sourceCardPolicy: Related PEZA/VAT cards must be labeled as related or supporting when not exact.
cases.sourceLimitationPolicy: Must state that directly governing authority was not located if only related sources are present.
forbiddenSections: definitive conclusion unsupported by governing authority
cases.tonePolicy: Senior tax memo with explicit caution.
cases.formattingPolicy: A-F memo may include a cautious conclusion rather than a definitive one.
cases.escalationPolicy: Request facts on PEZA registration, transaction type, buyer/seller status, and documentary support.
cases.risk: Fact-dependent PEZA VAT treatment can be overconfident with related-only sources.

cases.name: /tax NOLCO income tax senior memo format
cases.sourceCardPolicy: No source card should be fabricated when no indexed source is located.
cases.sourceLimitationPolicy: Must disclose that no indexed source was located for direct verification.
cases.tonePolicy: Professional and cautious; no false certainty.
cases.formattingPolicy: A-F memo may explain limits and missing source status instead of forcing a governing rule.
cases.escalationPolicy: Recommend source acquisition or narrower authority request if exact authority is required.
cases.risk: NO_INDEXED_SOURCE can be masked by formal memo language.

cases.name: /tax TRAIN and CREATE comparison senior memo format
cases.query: /tax compare TRAIN and CREATE treatment if relevant
cases.sourceCardPolicy: Separate TRAIN and CREATE source cards and do not merge their authority scopes.
cases.sourceLimitationPolicy: Identify limits if one authority is indexed more completely than the other.
cases.formattingPolicy: Use A-F memo sections with comparison/mapping inside Analysis.
cases.escalationPolicy: Ask the user to specify the tax type or transaction if 'treatment' is ambiguous.
cases.risk: Comparison can become too broad without user facts.
cases.notes: Mode-format comparison case from architecture review.

cases.name: /audit LOA validity advisory format
cases.sourceCardPolicy: Related procedural authorities must not be described as exact governing authority for the user's LOA.
cases.sourceLimitationPolicy: Must preserve related-authority caution if exact LOA authority is not indexed.
forbiddenSections: A-F tax memo only without audit defense sections
cases.tonePolicy: Professional audit advisory, prudent and action-oriented.
cases.formattingPolicy: Audit sections are mandatory; Risk level and Recommended action cannot be omitted.
cases.escalationPolicy: Already in /audit; request LOA date, taxable period, signatory, and scope.
cases.risk: LOA analysis is fact-sensitive and deadline-sensitive.

cases.name: /audit PAN/FAN mismatch advisory format
cases.sourceCardPolicy: Do not cite related procedural sources as controlling without exact authority.
cases.sourceLimitationPolicy: Must preserve source limitation wording when exact authority is absent.
cases.formattingPolicy: Include procedural issues and documentary support.
cases.escalationPolicy: Request PAN, FAN/FLD, dates, amounts, and disputed issues.
cases.risk: Procedural defects can be overstated without documents.

cases.name: /audit EWT deficiency with CWT support advisory format
cases.sourceCardPolicy: Exact EWT/CWT authorities may support the defense only within their scope.
cases.sourceLimitationPolicy: Do not omit caveats about document sufficiency and reconciliation.
cases.tonePolicy: Audit defense advisory with concrete document requests.
cases.formattingPolicy: Risk level must be explicit: LOW, MODERATE, HIGH, or INDEFENSIBLE.
cases.escalationPolicy: Already /audit; ask for CWT certificates, GL, returns, schedules, and assessment details.
cases.risk: Defense depends heavily on documents.

cases.name: /audit input VAT invoice mismatch advisory format
cases.sourceCardPolicy: Do not fabricate invoice/substantiation authority; distinguish general VAT rules from exact audit authority.
cases.sourceLimitationPolicy: State limits if only general VAT authority is available.
forbiddenSections: exact authority claim without indexed support
cases.formattingPolicy: Audit advisory format with explicit risk and action.
cases.escalationPolicy: Already /audit; request invoices, ORs/SIs, VAT returns, purchase lists, and BIR findings.
cases.risk: General VAT guidance may not resolve invoice mismatch facts.

cases.name: /audit subpoena or NTPR concern advisory format
cases.sourceCardPolicy: No source card should be fabricated for unavailable procedural authority.
cases.sourceLimitationPolicy: Must disclose no indexed source for direct verification and avoid invented deadlines or authority.
cases.formattingPolicy: Audit sections remain, but source limitation must be prominent.
cases.escalationPolicy: Recommend document review and current procedural authority check.
cases.risk: NO_INDEXED_SOURCE audit answers can create false procedural confidence.

cases.name: Related source card not described as governing
cases.query: /ask Are there jurisprudence cases on withholding tax?
cases.sourceCardPolicy: Clickable related source cards must be labeled and discussed as related/supporting only.
cases.sourceLimitationPolicy: Must preserve: Source limitation: A governing authority was not directly located. Displayed sources are related, supporting, or secondary only. They are not the controlling basis for the answer.
cases.formattingPolicy: The limitation must remain visible in conversational format.
cases.escalationPolicy: Recommend /tax for full legal analysis if the user needs a position.
cases.risk: Clickable cards can visually imply governing support.

cases.name: No source card does not become fabricated authority
cases.sourceCardPolicy: No source card should be shown or implied when the exact source is not indexed.
cases.sourceLimitationPolicy: Must preserve: Source limitation: No indexed source was located for direct verification.
cases.tonePolicy: Brief and firm about source unavailability.
cases.formattingPolicy: Do not fill the missing source with memo-style certainty.
cases.escalationPolicy: Suggest source acquisition/checking only as a future governance task, not a Phase 7A action.
cases.risk: Unavailable-source answers can substitute unrelated authority.
cases.notes: Locks no-source non-fabrication for conversational response work.

cases.name: Generic tax law non-promotion
cases.sourceCardPolicy: Do not attach a fabricated named authority or exact source card.
cases.sourceLimitationPolicy: May ask for a narrower question; no exact-source claim.
cases.formattingPolicy: Very short conversational response.
cases.escalationPolicy: Ask the user to specify tax type, transaction, authority, or issue.
cases.risk: Bare generic terms can accidentally trigger source promotion.

cases.name: Generic BIR issuance non-promotion
cases.sourceCardPolicy: Do not invent a Revenue Regulation, RMC, RMO, or BIR Ruling.
cases.sourceLimitationPolicy: Ask for issuance type/number/topic if exact authority is needed.
cases.formattingPolicy: No memo format.
cases.escalationPolicy: Recommend /source or a narrower /ask query if the user wants a specific issuance.
cases.risk: Generic issuance query may produce invented authority labels.

cases.name: Generic court case non-promotion
cases.sourceCardPolicy: Do not promote to a random CTA or Supreme Court case.
cases.sourceLimitationPolicy: Ask for case name, docket number, topic, or tax issue.
cases.formattingPolicy: No A-F memo or audit advisory.
cases.escalationPolicy: Recommend /tax only after a specific case or issue is supplied.
cases.risk: Generic case query can falsely map to known cases.

cases.name: Generic VAT case non-promotion
cases.sourceCardPolicy: Do not pick a VAT case unless the query identifies the issue or case.
cases.sourceLimitationPolicy: Ask for the VAT issue, case name, or docket.
cases.formattingPolicy: Short conversational guard response.
cases.escalationPolicy: Recommend /tax for a specific VAT issue analysis.
cases.risk: VAT generic terms may over-match to unrelated cases.

cases.name: Generic withholding tax case non-promotion
cases.sourceCardPolicy: Do not promote generic withholding-tax case wording to a specific G.R./CTA case.
cases.sourceLimitationPolicy: Ask for issue, party name, docket, or tax type if exact authority is required.
cases.formattingPolicy: No legal memo unless specific facts/authority are supplied.
cases.escalationPolicy: Recommend /tax after the user identifies the case or issue.
cases.risk: Generic WHT jurisprudence query can become false exact case promotion.

cases.name: Generic explain EWT non-promotion
cases.sourceCardPolicy: Do not require exact source-card promotion for generic EWT explanation.
cases.sourceLimitationPolicy: Use general explanation and suggest narrowing for exact authority.
cases.formattingPolicy: Short conversational explanation.
cases.escalationPolicy: Recommend /tax for rate/application questions.
cases.risk: Simple EWT request may over-trigger exact authority.

cases.name: Generic what is withholding tax non-promotion
cases.sourceCardPolicy: Do not require exact source-card promotion for a generic definition.
cases.sourceLimitationPolicy: Keep source note general unless exact authority is used.
cases.formattingPolicy: Short explanation first.
cases.escalationPolicy: Recommend /tax for payer/payee/rate/compliance treatment.
cases.risk: Generic definition can be confused with exact RR 2-98 treatment.

cases.name: /ask PAN EWT mode escalation advisory recommendation
cases.query: /ask We received a PAN for EWT deficiency. What should we do?
cases.sourceCardPolicy: Audit-related sources must remain related/supporting unless exact authority supports the defense.
cases.sourceLimitationPolicy: Preserve source limitation if exact governing audit authority is not located.
forbiddenSections: silent mode crossing without escalation signal
cases.tonePolicy: Professional and urgent but not alarmist.
cases.formattingPolicy: Escalated audit advisory structure is expected for PAN deficiency facts.
cases.escalationPolicy: Should recommend /audit or use audit internal mode while clearly signaling audit complexity.
cases.risk: Mode escalation can silently override user intent if not explained.
cases.notes: Mode escalation case required by architecture review.
